content:
Courtesy of Writer:  Kevin Shields

I just love this and it's a good one to play if, like me, you're not much of a singer!


Chords as I use:

[tab]   [ch]D5[/ch]    [ch]D[/ch]     [ch]Bm11/D[/ch]    [ch]Em11/D[/ch]    [ch]G5[/ch]     [ch]F#5[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]D2[/ch]   [ch]Aadd11/D[/ch]
E  x     2     0         0         x      x       0     0    0[/tab]
B  3     3     0         3         x      x       0     3    3
G  2     2     2         2         x      x       0     2    2
D  0     0     4         0         5      4       2     0    0
A  0     0     4         2         5      4       2     0    4
D  0     0     0         0         5      4       2     0    2



[Intro]
[ch]D5[/ch]        

[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
  Close my eyes[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bm11/D[/ch]
  Feel me now[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]                [ch]G5[/ch]
  I don't know maybe you could not love me now[/tab]
[tab][ch]F#5[/ch]                       [ch]Em[/ch]
  You will know, and her feet down to the ground[/tab]
[tab][ch]D5[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]
  Over there, and I want true love to love[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]            [ch]Bm11/D[/ch]          [ch]Em[/ch]
  You can't hide, oh no, from the way I feel[/tab]

[ch]D2[/ch] 

[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
  Turn my head[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bm11/D[/ch]
  Into sound[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]                 [ch]G5[/ch]
  I don't know when I lay down on the ground[/tab]
[tab][ch]F#5[/ch]                   [ch]Em[/ch]
  You will find the (way it) hurts to love[/tab]
[tab][ch]D5[/ch]                   [ch]Em[/ch]
  Never cared and the world turned hearts to love[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]          [ch]Bm11/D[/ch]         [ch]Em[/ch]
  You will see, oh now, oh the way I do[/tab]

[ch]Em11/D[/ch] 

[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
  You will wait[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bm11/D[/ch]
  See me go[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]                    [ch]G5[/ch]
  I don't care when your head turned all alone[/tab]
[tab][ch]F#5[/ch]                     [ch]Em[/ch]
  You will wait when I turn my eyes around[/tab]
[tab][ch]D5[/ch]                [ch]Em[/ch]
  Overhead when I hold you next to me[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]      [ch]Bm11/D[/ch]          [ch]Em[/ch]
  Overhead, to know, oh the way I see[/tab]

[ch]D2[/ch] 

[Verse 4]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
  Close my eyes[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bm11/D[/ch]
  Feel me how[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]                [ch]G5[/ch]
  I don't know maybe you could not hurt me now[/tab]
[tab][ch]F#5[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]
  Here alone when I feel down too[/tab]
[tab][ch]D5[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]
  Over there when I await true love for you[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]          [ch]Bm11/D[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]
  You can hide, oh no, oh the way I do[/tab]
[ch]D2[/ch]

[tab][ch]Em11/D[/ch]          [ch]Bm11/D[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]
  You will see, oh now, oh the way I do[/tab]

[ch]Em11/D[/ch] 
  

(play verse 1 without lyrics through twice)

Finish with a few bars of Aadd11/D
